description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-034 Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Technician against its five linked RAC records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's own governed module headings; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. COURSE-034 is the 12-month full-time NVQ Level 4 course. NYSC citations keep the exact governed text; where the snapshot holds a verified display correction for that heading, display_text carries the corrected wording. Comparator cells are shared with the other RAC course because the five records and their cited text are identical. Classifications follow the Step 14D audit (2026-10-18). Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text. Step 16 (2026-10-18): cells whose verified note states a narrower TESDA equipment scope are flagged scope_limited; UEE32225's refrigerant-regulation scope passage was added to its environmental-practice citations.

columns.short_label: TESDA Commercial AC NC III · Philippines

refrigeration_cycle_components: refrigeration principles or the vapour-compression cycle
named cycle components (compressor, condenser, evaporator, expansion or flow control, drier or filter)
refrigerants_environment: refrigerant environmental or regulatory practice, or explicit environmental procedures
domestic_refrigeration: servicing, maintenance or repair of domestic refrigeration appliances
commercial_refrigeration: installation or servicing of commercial or industrial refrigeration systems (cold rooms, walk-in coolers or cold storage, ice plants, commercial compressors, low- or medium-temperature systems)
ac_servicing_repair: servicing, maintenance or repair of air-conditioning units
central_ducted_ac: a central or ducted air-conditioning system (central plant, DX or chilled-water, chillers) with operation, installation or servicing
fault_diagnosis_testing: fault diagnosis, troubleshooting or fault finding
workplace_safety: general workplace or occupational safety and health practice, or hazard identification

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (for TESDA, unit titles; for UEE32225, core unit titles).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: NYSC heading 1 names display units and bottle coolers for repair: commercial refrigeration is PARTIAL, not FULL.

UEERE0001 (environmentally and sustainable procedures in the energy sector) is accepted as the environmental component of refrigerants practice; TESDA's general environmental basic competency is assessed the same way.
UEERA0052/UEERA0053 low- and medium-temperature systems are accepted as commercial refrigeration evidence.
TESDA DomRAC covers window-type AC and domestic refrigerators only; its AC cells carry that scope note. Commercial AC NC III covers commercial AC units only.
Refrigerant-handling safety (e.g. UEERA0079) is assessed under refrigerants practice, not workplace safety.
DGT LO55 and LO56 repeat LO25 and LO26 and are not cited.
